name: Atomic Addons for Elementor & WooCommerce Extensions
author: Oyorox

sections.description:
Atomic Addons is a comprehensive plugin designed to supercharge your Elementor page builder with powerful, easy-to-use widgets. Perfect for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users who want to create stunning, fully customized websites.

Why Atomic Addons?

  • Free and Pro widgets are documented separately below so availability is clear before installation or upgrade
  • WordPress.org package includes free widgets, free extensions, and core plugin features
  • Atomic Addons Pro unlocks additional Pro widgets, Pro extensions, and premium features
  • 5 free extensions and 16 Pro extensions for sections and columns
  • Features: Template Library, SVG Support, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator (free); Mega Menu, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, Variation Swatches (Pro)
  • Mobile-first, responsive controls
  • WooCommerce widgets (grids, carousels, pricing, reviews)
  • Smooth animations and effects
  • Lightweight assets and performance-oriented defaults
  • Regular updates and friendly support

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload atomic-elements folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
Does your plugin support all WordPress themes?

  • Yes, the Atomic Addons is compatible and supports all WordPress themes including popular free and premium Elementor themes.

What do I need to use the plugin?

  • Just install Atomic Addons along with Elementor page builder; that’s all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential widgets to help you create your blogging site in minutes.

Do you provide tutorials on the plugin?

  • Of course, we provide detailed documentation and video to support our users with thorough guidelines for our plugins and widgets.

How do I get a solution for any issue?

  • Just contact us and we will follow up within 24 hours with our expert technical team.

How should I get updates and support

  • When we release a update version, then automatically you will get a notification on WordPress plugin manager, so you can update from there. Thereafter you want to update manually just knock us, we will send you update version via mail.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4 [30th July 2026]

  • Fixed: Theme Builder fatal error on Post Content (atomel_set_single_post_preview_data undefined)
  • Fixed: Theme Builder Post Content preview/excerpt rendering
  • Fixed: WooCommerce disabled extensions no longer show settings or product meta in admin
  • Fixed: WooCommerce Settings page only lists enabled extensions
  • Fixed: WooCommerce Extensions grid Settings button follows on/off toggle
  • Fixed: WooCommerce settings save blocked when the extension is off

1.1.2 [14th July 2026]

  • Fixed: Activate issue Fixed

1.1.1 [14th July 2026]

  • Updated: System udpate

1.1.0 [10th July 2026]

Added

  • WooCommerce Currency Switcher extension (multi-currency, exchange rates, shortcode [atomel_currency_switcher])
  • WooCommerce Quick View extension (AJAX product preview modal)
  • WooCommerce Product Compare extension (floating bar, comparison table, shortcode [atomel_compare])
  • WooCommerce Wishlist extension (user meta + cookie storage, My Account tab, shortcode [atomel_wishlist])
  • Checkout Field Editor ported as a native WooCommerce extension (classic + block checkout)
  • Variation Swatches moved from Features to WooCommerce extensions
  • Wishlist, Compare, and Quick View action buttons on Elementor Product Grid, Product Carousel, and Product List widgets (Additional → Action btn switchers)
  • Shared WooCommerce settings UI helper (atomel-wcx-*) for extension settings panels
  • Compare products & wishlist products widgets added

1.0.7 [9th June 2026]

  • Changed: Admin dashboard light theme refresh; styles moved from PHP to SCSS
  • Fixed: Toast notifications and Save Changes button colors

1.0.6 [14th May 2026]

  • Added: WooCommerce Subscriptions extension added
  • Added: WooCommerce One Page Checkout extension added
  • Added: WooCommerce Role Based Pricing extension added
  • Added: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Everest Forms widgets added

1.0.4 [11th May 2026]

  • Added: Image Accordion, Image Expand, Hover Box and Hover video widgets added

1.0.3 [1st May 2026]

  • Added: Total Count, User Register & Image Compare widgets unlocked from the pro version

1.0.2 [14th April 2026]

  • Added: Search, Navbar, Barcode widgets unlocked from the pro version

1.0.1 [10th April 2026]

  • Updated: Readme lists aligned with Free (WordPress.org) vs Pro packaging — widgets, extensions, and features
  • Documented: Free widgets in the WordPress.org package (16): Accordion, Age Gate, Animated Link, Brand Carousel, Brand Grid, Call Out, Creative Button, Dual Button, Fancy List, Featured Box, Forminator Forms, Image Stack, Mobile Menu, Scrollnav, Slider, Static Carousel
  • Added: Free extensions in the org package: Backdrop Filter, Grid Line, Ripple Effects, Tooltip, Wrapper Link
  • Documented: Free features — Live Copy Paste, Duplicator, Template Library, SVG Support; Pro features — Mega Menu, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, Variation Swatches

1.0.0

  • Added: Initial Release
